d:
American billionaire and owner of X, Elon Musk, has deleted a controversial post he made during the midterm elections, in which he had urged voters to support Republican candidates. During the election, Musk spent at least $458 million—approximately 4,400 crore rupees—on campaigning for Republican candidates. Following the party's defeat in the election, Musk has also seen a significant decline in his net worth.
